abilities.title: Ogre Seal Flop
abilities.description: Flop forward like an ogre seal 2 times, dealing 250 damage and slowing enemies in a 275 radius by -100% for 1.5 second on each bounce. 400 bounce distance.

subject: orb_of_destruction
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

abilities.title: Impeding Corruption
abilities.description: Attacks reduce the target's armor and movement speed. Slow amount varies based on whether the wearer is melee or ranged.

abilities.title: Maim
abilities.description: Each attack has a 25% chance to reduce enemy hero movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 60 for 3 seconds.

subject: rattlecage
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

abilities.title: Reverberate
abilities.description: After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 90 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.

context.notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

subject: shredder_chakram
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

context.description_en: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
context.description_zh: 伐木机将主锯刃射向目标区域，锯刃会高速旋转，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被降低。锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。在发射锯刃后伐木机将无法攻击，同时会持续消耗魔法。
notes_en: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.
notes_zh: 如果伐木机魔法不足或移动超过%break_distance%距离，锯齿飞轮将会飞回。

subject: stormcrafter
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

abilities.title: Bottled Lightning
abilities.description: Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 70 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.

subject: tusk_tag_team
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

context.description_en: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续%debuff_duration%秒。
notes_en: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.
notes_zh: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。

subject: unrelenting_eye
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

abilities.title: Relentless
abilities.description: Increases slow resistance by 50%. This bonus is reduced by 10% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.

subject: zuus_heavenly_jump
definition: 降低移动速度或攻击速度

context.description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
context.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。

context.description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。

abilities.title: False Flight
abilities.description: Gain 50% slow resistance, phased movement, and 35% evasion for 6.5 seconds.

abilities.title: Veiled
abilities.description: When falling below 50% HP, gain 150% evasion for 5 seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by 75% of its current value.

abilities.title: Last Caress
abilities.description: Veiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.

context.notes: Does not trigger from damage by non-player controlled creeps

subject: arc_warden_tempest_double
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

context.description_en: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
context.description_zh: 天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
notes_en: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
notes_zh: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。

shard_loc.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。不会触发神符灌注。

subject: black_powder_bag
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

abilities.title: Hair Trigger
abilities.description: The next time you get attacked by a hero within 400 range, explode dealing 250 damage to all enemies within a 400 radius and causing them to miss 100% of their attacks for 2 seconds.

subject: kez_ravens_veil
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

context.description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
context.description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。

subject: light_collector
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

subject: riki_smoke_screen
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

context.description_en: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
context.description_zh: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
notes_en: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
notes_zh: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。

shard_loc.en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.
shard_loc.zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

subject: ringmaster_spotlight
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空

context.description_en: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
context.description_zh: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。

subject: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
definition: 使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
subject_zh: 巨魔战将·旋风飞斧（近战）

context.description_en: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
context.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: venomancer_plague_ward
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）

context.description_en: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
context.description_zh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。

subject: outworld_staff
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向

abilities.title: Self-Exile
abilities.description: Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for 0.7 seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes 5% of their maximum health as damage.

context.notes: Damage taken when returning is non-lethal and disables Blink Dagger and other items that are muted upon taking damage.

subject: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向

context.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

shard_loc.en: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
shard_loc.zh: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

subject: gale_guard
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）

abilities.title: Cyclonic Shield
abilities.description: Envelops the caster in an all damage barrier that absorbs 75% of incoming damage up to a max of 225. Lasts for up to 10 seconds and while the barrier is active you have 50% Slow Resistance.

subject: hood_of_defiance
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）

abilities.title: Barrier
abilities.description: Creates a spell shield that absorbs up to 350 magical damage. Lasts 12 seconds.

context.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

subject: infused_raindrop
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）

abilities.title: Magical Damage Block
abilities.description:
Consumes a charge to block 120 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage. 

Comes with 6 charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.

context.notes: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

subject: miniboss_minion_summoner
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）

subject: poor_mans_shield
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）

abilities.title: Damage Block
abilities.description:
Gives a 100% chance to block 30 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 20 damage on ranged.

Has a 50% chance to block damage from creeps.

context.notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
